description_en: Cancels device upgrade jobs in a specified batch
description_zh: 调用该接口取消指定批次下的设备升级作业
name: CancelOTATaskByJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the upgrade batch.

This is the JobId returned when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html to create the batch. You can also view this value on the Firmware Details page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
升级批次ID。

您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html创建批次返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台固件的**固件详情**页查看
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to cancel device upgrade jobs in a scheduled upgrade batch. A scheduled upgrade batch is created by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html with the ScheduleTime parameter specified. Valid values:

true: Cancel.
false (default): Do not cancel
parameters.help_zh:
取消定时升级批次下的设备升级作业，即调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html时，传入了**ScheduleTime**参数创建的升级批次。取值：

true：取消。
false（默认）：不取消
parameters.name: cancel_scheduled_task

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the QUEUED (pending push) state in the batch. Valid values:

true: Cancel.
false (default): Do not cancel.

<notice>If this parameter is set to true and the CancelUnconfirmedTask parameter is specified, only device upgrade jobs in the pending push state are canceled. If this parameter is set to true and the CancelUnconfirmedTask parameter is not specified, device upgrade jobs in both the pending confirmation and pending push states are canceled.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
取消批次下所有状态为待推送（QUEUED）的设备升级作业。取值：

true：取消。
false（默认）：不取消。

<notice>该参数值为true时，如果传入CancelUnconfirmedTask参数值，则仅取消待推送状态的设备升级作业；如果不传入CancelUnconfirmedTask参数值，则会取消待确认和待推送状态的设备升级任务。
</notice>
parameters.name: cancel_queued_task

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the IN_PROGRESS (upgrading) state in the batch. Valid values:

true: Cancel.
false (default): Do not cancel
parameters.help_zh:
取消批次下所有状态为升级中（IN_PROGRESS）的设备升级作业。取值：

true：取消。
false（默认）：不取消
parameters.name: cancel_in_progress_task

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the NOTIFIED (pushed) state in the batch. Valid values:

true: Cancel.
false (default): Do not cancel
parameters.help_zh:
取消批次下所有状态为已推送（NOTIFIED）的设备升级作业。取值：

true：取消。
false（默认）：不取消
parameters.name: cancel_notified_task

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the CONFIRM (pending confirmation) state in the batch. Valid values:

true: Cancel.
false: Do not cancel.

Default value: empty.

<notice>If this parameter is not specified and CancelQueuedTask is set to true, device upgrade jobs in the pending confirmation state are also canceled. If this parameter is not specified and CancelQueuedTask is set to false, device upgrade jobs in the pending confirmation state are not canceled.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
取消批次下所有状态为待确认（CONFIRM）的设备升级作业。取值：

true：取消。
false：不取消。

默认值为空。

<notice>如果不传入此参数，当CancelQueuedTask值为true时，会同步取消待确认状态的设备升级任务；当CancelQueuedTask值为false时，不会取消待确认状态的设备升级作业。
</notice>
parameters.name: cancel_unconfirmed_task
